seen_before_registration: All results of extension_v16. question: Does the Mahalanobis (and any other) rejection of the fold-1 CNNs change when the checkpoint is the last epoch instead of the one selected by validation accuracy with early stopping?
scope: Fold 1, seed 42, each of the eight classes removed, RGB and RGBE: 16 training runs. Fold 1 is the fold named by the review; 14 of its 16 stored checkpoints were selected before epoch 10.
training: The CNN recipe, inputs and seed of extension_v16 (run_extension_v5.train_cnn_loco, fold-parametrised as in v16) with one change: the patience rule does not stop the training, which runs for all 40 requested epochs (the learning-rate schedule is unchanged). Two checkpoints of the same training run are kept. RULE: the weights the registered rule selects in this run (best validation session-balanced accuracy, ties by lower validation loss, among the epochs up to the one at which patience 8 would have stopped). LAST: the weights after epoch 40. The source difference is written to reports/extension_v17/code_patches.diff.
runs: {rgb|rgbe}_loco_{c}_f1_s42_v17last and {rgb|rgbe}_loco_{c}_f1_s42_v17rule (the second is a copy of the RULE weights and validation predictions of the same training run)
evaluation: Both checkpoints, exactly as the stored runs in extension_v16: legacy evaluation, re-extracted logits and features, class means and shared covariance from the training images of that checkpoint, the four scores (msp log-odds, maxlogit, energy, maha) in float64, image threshold per model and score = value at index int(0.05 n) of the sorted VAL scores, session vote. Door-level points of extension_v16 C2: validation-door threshold, post-hoc point, door AUROC.
reporting: For STORED (the v16 runs), RULE and LAST, each CNN and each score: unregistered doors rejected of 73, per removed class with the classes they were accepted as; registered-door decisions correct / rejected / wrong of 511; closed-set door accuracy of the registered doors; image AUROC and door AUROC (mean and minimum over the eight runs); the same counts at the validation-door threshold. Per run: rule epoch of the stored run and of the rerun, the epoch at which patience would have stopped, validation session-balanced accuracy at the rule epoch and at epoch 40.
claim_rule: Everything is reported whatever its direction. Tables 6 and 7 keep the stored results of the registered selection rule. RULE is a replication check of STORED: a difference between them is run-to-run variation, not an effect of the epoch, and is reported as such. Wording for the Mahalanobis score, with L = doors rejected by LAST and R = doors rejected by RULE (of 73): (a) if |L - R| <= 5 and L < 73 for both CNNs, the manuscript states that the last-epoch checkpoints gave a similar count and the conclusion keeps its statement that this CNN accepted unregistered doors as classes of another model; (b) if L = 73 for both CNNs, the manuscript states that the last-epoch checkpoints rejected every fold-1 door and the conclusion restates that difference as a dependence on checkpoint selection; (c) in every other case both counts are given, the rejection is described as sensitive to checkpoint selection, and the conclusion states the difference with both checkpoints. The scores, thresholds and vote are not changed.
rules: Nothing existing is overwritten; outputs go to runs/*_v17last, runs/*_v17rule, reports/extension_v17/, cache/extension_v17/. No threshold, rule or metric is changed after seeing outputs. A technical failure is fixed without changing the analysis, re-run, and noted in reports/extension_v17/run_notes.json.
